mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sale_log ( unique_idx, user_uuid, product_eng_name, ins_data, ins_ip, ins_machine ) VALUES ( #{unique_idx}, #{user_uuid}, #{product_eng_name}, Now(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_data SET product_sale_count=product_sale_count+1 WHERE product_eng_name = #{product_eng_name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO use_cash_log (user_uuid, user_platform, use_cash_unique_idx, use_cash_product_name, use_cash_quantity, ins_date, ins_ip, ins_machine) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, #{platform}, #{use_cash_unique_idx}, #{use_cash_product_name}, #{use_cash_quantity}, Now(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.*, CASE WHEN b.product_eng_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS first_buy FROM product_data a LEFT JOIN product_sale_log b ON a.product_eng_name = b.product_eng_name AND b.user_uuid = #{user_uuid} where a.product_eng_name = #{product_eng_name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exp_booster_data (user_uuid, exp_booster_start_date, exp_booster_end_date, exp_booster_buy_count) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, Now(), ADDDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE exp_booster_data SET exp_booster_start_date=NOW(), exp_booster_end_date=ADDDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), exp_booster_buy_count=exp_booster_buy_count+1 WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT exp_booster_start_date, exp_booster_end_date, CASE WHEN Now() BETWEEN exp_booster_start_date AND exp_booster_end_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS 'booster_yn' FROM exp_booster_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
